en_text: Sorry... I'll try to keep my distance.

en_text: Can you help me pull out a scale? I need it to cool the cannon barrel.

en_text: I found my way here on my own.
The little wolf, the hedgehog, the owl...

en_text: This place is different from outside.
It's like it's protected by a warm light.
cn_text: 像是被温暖的光保护着。

en_text: I want to stay here with all of you.
cn_text: 我想留在这里，和你们一起。

en_text: Don't worry. Everyone can find food on their own.
cn_text: 不用担心，大家会自己找食物的。

en_text: You have to defeat the bad witch...

en_text: The forest used to be our home...
I don't want to lose any more friends...

Huh? They like you that much?
You haven't been sneaking them food, have you?

en_text: Where did my ball bearing go?!
cn_text: 我那颗轴承珠怎么不见了！？

en_text: Huh? I have no idea at all~

en_text: Mm... could you arm-wrestle my bear?

en_text: the world was never the same again.
cn_text: 世界再也不是从前的样子了。

en_text: Dark magic corrupted the land, and even the dead could not rest.
cn_text: 黑魔法侵蚀大地，连死者也无法安息。

en_text: Now the villages, roads, and fields outside are full of wandering dead.
cn_text: 如今外面的村庄、道路和田野，到处都是游荡的亡者。

en_text: That is why everyone came to see this place as a shelter.
cn_text: 所以大家才把这里当成了避难所。

en_text: At first, people only came here to hide for a while.
cn_text: 一开始大家只是来这里暂时躲避。

en_text: Then more and more arrived, and no one dared return to their homes outside.
cn_text: 后来人越来越多，再也没人敢回到外面的屋子。

en_text: Some sealed the windows. Some piled barricades at the doors.
cn_text: 有人封住窗户，有人在门口堆起路障。

en_text: And somehow, we have held out here until now.
cn_text: 大家就在这里撑到了现在。

en_text: We had quite a bit of grain stored here for feeding the poor.
cn_text: 这里存了不少用来救济穷人的粮食。

en_text: So when everyone first took shelter here, we could manage for a while.
cn_text: 所以大家刚躲进来的时候，还能撑一阵子。

en_text: But food runs out eventually, and some have begun going outside to gather wild greens and the like.
cn_text: 不过粮食终究会吃完，也有人开始出去找些野菜之类的。

en_text: Ron went out some time ago, and he has not come back yet.
cn_text: 罗恩前阵子就出去了，到现在还没回来。

en_text: Don't worry too much about us. What you have to do is far more dangerous.
cn_text: 别太担心我们，你要做的事情，比这更危险。

en_text: Ella prays for everyone every day. That crystal pendant glows faintly when she does.
cn_text: 艾拉每天都会为大家祈祷。那条水晶吊坠在祈祷时会微微发光。

en_text: I do not know what that means.
cn_text: 我不知道那意味着什么。

en_text: But at least for now, those things rarely come near this place anymore.
cn_text: 但至少到现在，那些东西变得很少靠近这里了。

en_text: That crystal pendant has been with Ella ever since I found her.
cn_text: 从我发现艾拉的时候起，这条水晶吊坠就一直在她身边。

en_text: Even Ella cannot explain exactly what power it holds.
cn_text: 艾拉自己也说不清它到底拥有什么力量。

en_text: Perhaps it is some ancient blessing.
cn_text: 也许是某种古老的祝福。

en_text: It was thanks to that pendant that Ella sensed you out there, injured.
cn_text: 当初也是靠着它，艾拉才在外面感知到了受伤的你。

en_text: That is how everyone found you and brought you back here.
cn_text: 大家才能找到，并把你带回了这里。

en_text: These things are magical residue left behind by the Black Witch.
cn_text: 这些东西是黑魔女留下的法力残渣。

en_text: They spread throughout the kingdom in the wake of the cult's rampage.
cn_text: 随着那些教团的肆虐被带到了整个王国。

en_text: If ordinary people so much as touch them, the black flame quickly consumes them.
cn_text: 一般人的只要碰到它，很快就会被这黑火所吞噬。

en_text: In the end, they become one of those things too.
cn_text: 最后也会变成那些东西的一员。

en_text: Yet you can withstand their power.
cn_text: 可你却能承受它的力量。

en_text: That is why Ella believes you may truly be able to save this world.
cn_text: 所以艾拉相信，你也许真的能拯救这个世界。

en_text: Those people in black robes are the Witch's followers.
cn_text: 那些穿黑袍的人是魔女的信徒。

en_text: When they first came, they said the Witch would bring a new age.
cn_text: 他们刚来的时候说魔女会带来全新的时代。

en_text: They said magic would give everyone better lives.
cn_text: 说魔法会让大家过上更好的日子。

en_text: Back then, quite a few people followed them.
cn_text: 当时有不少人跟着他们走了。

en_text: But later, dark magic poisoned the crops, and even the dead could no longer rest.
cn_text: 可后来，黑魔法污染了庄稼，就连死者也无法安息。

en_text: And that was the end of life as we knew it.
cn_text: 大家的日子，也就全完了。

en_text: Some say the Black Witch's spells are sealed inside them.
cn_text: 有人说，那里面封印着黑魔女的法术。

en_text: But I hear they are not truly fixed spells.
cn_text: 不过听说那其实不是固定的法术。

en_text: They simply magnify the wicked thoughts in people's hearts.
cn_text: 它只是把人们心中的邪念放大。

en_text: So with things like that... it is best not to trust them too much.
cn_text: 所以这种东西……最好不要太相信。

en_text: You should know what the village is like.
cn_text: 村里的情况你应该了解。

en_text: If you go farther out, you must first cross that forest.
cn_text: 如果往外走，要先穿越那片森林。

en_text: But that place was corrupted by dark magic long ago, and no one dares pass through anymore.
cn_text: 可那地方早就被黑魔法腐化，再也没有人敢过。

en_text: Those who barely escaped before say many towns have already been abandoned.
cn_text: 听之前侥幸逃出来的人说，很多城镇已经没人在居住了。

en_text: As for the Black Witch... they say she is still on her throne.
cn_text: 至于黑魔女……听说她还在她的王座上。

en_text: I hear there is nothing human left beneath those cultists' black robes.
cn_text: 听说那些教徒的黑袍下面，早就没有人样了。

en_text: That power is far too dangerous. Even you cannot be exposed to it for long.
cn_text: 那种力量太危险。就算是你也不能长时间的接触。

en_text: That is why Ella purifies the darkness left in you every time.
cn_text: 所以艾拉每次都会帮你净化身上残留的黑暗。

en_text: On the day the Witch's Tide began, I was there too.
cn_text: 魔女之潮开始的那一天，我也在那里

en_text: I saw her once from afar, among the crowd.
cn_text: 人群里，我远远见过她一眼。

en_text: She wore a splendid long dress, yet looked somewhat frail.
cn_text: 穿得很华丽的长裙，却显得稍稍有些瘦弱。

en_text: I don't remember the look on her face then.
cn_text: 我不记得她当时是什么表情了。

en_text: At the time, no one knew what would happen next.
cn_text: 那时候，没有人知道接下来会发生什么。

en_text: No one knew how the princess could be a witch.
cn_text: 谁也不知道为什么公主竟是一个魔女。

en_text: After that day, so many things people had believed in simply fell apart.
cn_text: 那一天之后，很多人原本相信的东西都不复存在了。

en_text: She declared that dark magic would no longer be forbidden.

en_text: Demons and zealots flocked to her banner.

en_text: Everyone was forced to accept this new kingdom of ash.
